sections.section_title: DCMIPP Pipe1 pixel packer Memory0 address register 1 (DCMIPP_P1PPM0AR1)
sections.text_helper: Section 39.14.86 "DCMIPP Pipe1 pixel packer Memory0 address register 1 (DCMIPP_P1PPM0AR1)" in chapter 39 (Digital camera interface pixel pipeline (DCMIPP)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 1959.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x9C4
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:0 M0A[31:0]: Memory0 address
Base address of memory area 0, to whom data are written. It is assumed to be a multiple of
16, hence its bits 3:0 are always at 0x0.
